en: Sepia-toned photograph mounted with a light border, showing a street corner with an old, battered brick house and, in front of it, a low crenellated wall and gate built in a faux-medieval style. The wall has merlons, narrow arched openings, and a tall pointed-arch gateway facing the cobblestone street. There are tram or trolley tracks in the foreground. Any caption at the bottom is extremely faint and not legible.
